RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST.status: the ACTION stands; the RATIONALE below is WITHDRAWN
RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST.retracted_text_verbatim: Reserve a shard queried EXACTLY ONCE for the headline design number. Repeated interrogation of a single frozen scoring split overfits invisibly -- each decision taken after looking at it tunes to it, without any step that looks like fitting.
RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST.why_it_is_wrong: The shared-split offset does not grow with the number of looks, and it CANCELS in a candidate-versus-candidate difference. What grows is SELECTION, with multiplier M = the number of candidates the split's feedback INFORMED -- not the number of times the split was read. So 'repeated interrogation overfits invisibly' names the wrong quantity, and a query cap does not address the real one.
RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST.source: Correction relayed 2026-11-22 from the P2 tokenization-axis session, which had supplied the original query-budget guidance and withdrew it: 'please don't implement what I told you ... Reserving a final shard is still fine as prudence, but it is not the mechanism and shouldn't drive the design.'

what_the_corrected_accounting_says_about.the_two_spent_queries_are_NOT_equivalent: This file counted two spent queries on folds 9-10 and treated them alike. They are not alike. The oracle gate was PRE-SPECIFIED in its own script before it ran, so it contributes ~nothing to M and should not have been counted. The verdict-threshold change -- absolute to ceiling-relative, using a ceiling derived from folds 9-10 -- is an ADAPTIVE follow-on and is the single real exposure here. It is worse than a query: the verdict RULE was informed by the held-out data.
what_the_corrected_accounting_says_about.so_the_correction_cuts_both_ways: Sharper on the item that matters, more forgiving on the item being counted. Not a wash, and it must not be reported as one.
what_the_corrected_accounting_says_about.the_remedy_changes_accordingly: Not 'query fold 10 exactly once', which addresses nothing. Re-derive the ceiling on fold 9 ALONE and keep every parameter of the ceiling-relative rule off fold 10. That was already this arm's outstanding re-measurement item; the corrected mechanism promotes it from tidy-up to load-bearing.

RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST.what_still_stands: Reserving fold 10 remains worth doing as prudence and costs only discipline here. The retrospective-exposure accounting below also stands as a factual record of what was read and when. Only the causal story -- that look-count is the thing being guarded against -- is withdrawn.

why_a_separate_artifact: The bar is FROZEN. Amending a frozen bar to add a reservation it did not contain would defeat the point of freezing it, so this is a separate, later, additive commitment that references the bar rather than editing it.
purpose: [RATIONALE RETRACTED 2026-11-22 -- see RETRACTED_MECHANISM_READ_THIS_FIRST above. The action stands: fold 10 is reserved and queried once, as prudence. The mechanism originally given here named look-count, which is not what overfits; SELECTION is, counted over candidates the split's feedback informed.]

HONEST_ACCOUNTING_THE_RESERVATION_IS_RET.problem: A final-only shard must be untouched BEFORE scoring begins. Folds 9-10 had already been queried twice when this reservation was made, so a genuinely virgin shard cannot be manufactured retroactively. Recording that rather than asserting a cleanliness that does not exist.

queries_already_spent_on_folds_9_10.note: the oracle was fit on folds 7-8 ONLY; folds 9-10 served as its test set

queries_already_spent_on_folds_9_10.what: real_ceiling arm of the activity-stratified null
queries_already_spent_on_folds_9_10.note: real sequence stratified by its own measured activity, scored by the folds-7-8 oracle

decisions_taken_after_seeing_those_numbe: the oracle gate PASS (control zero cleared)
replacing an absolute verdict threshold with a ceiling-relative one, where the ceiling itself came from folds 9-10
HONEST_ACCOUNTING_THE_RESERVATION_IS_RET.bounded_because: both queries produced AGGREGATE statistics (a Spearman, a monotonicity) rather than per-sequence decisions, and neither fit parameters to folds 9-10. So the adaptive exposure is real but small. It is NOT zero and must not be described as zero.
HONEST_ACCOUNTING_THE_RESERVATION_IS_RET.HepG2_is_cleaner_than_K562: the stratified null ran on K562 only, so HepG2 folds 9-10 carry ONE spent query (the oracle gate) rather than two.

FINAL_ONLY.rule: queried EXACTLY ONCE, for the headline design number, after every other decision is settled. No tuning, no threshold selection, no geometry choice, and no verdict-rule change may be informed by it.

WORKING_HELD_OUT.rule: the set every intermediate decision is made against -- oracle re-validation, null calibration, geometry grid, threshold derivation. Interrogate freely; it is spent by design.

reservation_going_forward.consequence_to_apply: The oracle accuracy and the ceiling were both measured on folds 9+10 combined. Going forward both are RE-MEASURED on fold 9 alone, and the combined 9+10 figures are retired to 'already spent' rather than quoted as held-out. The numbers will move slightly; that movement is the price of the reservation and is not a finding.

why_this_is_affordable_here_and_was_not_: On the E. coli arm the scoring split was pinned by nine frozen COMPARISON_GEOMETRY_FIELDS and every committed number was measured against it, so carving a shard out would have orphaned the existing anchors. The human track has no committed anchors yet, so a reservation costs nothing but discipline.
honest_limits: A retrospective reservation is weaker than a prospective one. The right time to carve this was before the oracle ran.

Fold 10 is ~6.1k (HepG2) and ~9.8k (K562) sequences, so a single headline query on it is adequately powered for a monotonicity statistic but gives no second chance if the run is misconfigured. The run must be rehearsed end-to-end on fold 9 first.

7819 elements are shared between the two cell libraries and fold assignment is per-cell, so fold 10 of HepG2 and fold 10 of K562 are NOT independent shards. A cross-cell headline must exclude the shared elements.
